items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Fulbright was with Teddy Hill... And Edmund Hall... Dick Fulbright... you and Clarence Palmer the vocalist... you were with that band about a year then.

ctx.x: No, guitar. I forget the bass player's name. We used to call him Fat Man, never did call him by his name.
It wasn't Fulbright, by any chance.

No, Fulbright was with Teddy Hill. We never called Fat Man by his first name. That's the reason why I can't remember it. And I haven't seen him since that band broke up. I don't know what happened to him.**
